{{Quote|While the two scripts are similar, small variances differentiate the Royal Script from the Naboo Futhark, a fact made eminently clear when Senator Binks of Naboo famously misinterpreted the name of the Palazzo's Heroine Hall as 'Hero in Hell' during Queen Apailana's state visit to the world.|Doctor Milanda Vorgan|<ref name="Written" />}}
The '''Royal Script of Grizmallt''' was a [[Writing/Legends|written]] [[Language/Legends|language]] that involved oval designs, used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]] by the<ref name="Written" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Grizmallti/Legends|Grizmallti]].<ref name="Nexus">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> It was displayed on the [[Palazzo Reina]] and other buildings constructed during the reign of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Elsinoré den Tasia]],<ref name="Written" /> which began by [[3950 BBY]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and ended in approximately [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]].<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> The script developed into the [[Futhark/Legends|Futhark]] language after the [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] of<ref name="Written" /> the planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by the Grizmallti. Futhark and the Royal Script of Grizmallt were very similar, with only small differences.<ref name="Written" />

In a famous incident during a state visit to Grizmallt by [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]]<ref name="Written" /> of Naboo<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|queenapailana|Apailana, Queen}}</ref> between [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]<ref name="21 BBY">[[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana's]] reign began after that of [[Neeyutnee/Legends|Neeyutnee]], who was in power during the events of "[[Crisis on Naboo]]," which took place in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] according to {{FactFile2014|57|EVA 1-2|Moralo Eval}}.</ref> and [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="Endnotes">{{Blog|JSarek|8|Endnotes for The Written Word}}</ref> Naboo [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] mistakenly interpreted the name of Palazzo Reina's [[Heroine Hall]] as "Hero in Hell." The Royal Script of Grizmallt was acknowledged in "[[The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic]]," an article published in [[38 ABY]] by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Milanda Vorgan]].<ref name="Written" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Jar-Jar's 'diplomatic incident' with Queen Apailana during her state visit to Grizmallt seemed a good way to hint at the orthographic drift between the Naboo and their forebears, and to have a little fun with a certain klutzy Gungan, of whom we've seen so little in the post-RotS timeframe.|John Hazlett, in the endnotes for "The Written Word"|<ref name="Endnotes" />}}
The Royal Script of Grizmallt was mentioned in "[[The Written Word]]," an [[in-universe]] article written by [[John Hazlett]] and published on [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club]], a subscription feature on [[StarWars.com]],<ref name="Written" /> on [[March 5]], [[2010]].<ref name="Pub date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30796355|board=Literature|thread=Hyperspace New Short Fiction: JJM's "The Secret Journal of Doctor Demagol" now online!!!|user=[[Nathan O'Keefe|Valin_Kenobi]]|date=2010-03-05|time=12:25 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20171006225114/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/hyperspace-new-short-fiction-jjms-the-secret-journal-of-doctor-demagol-now-online.28297369/page-16}}</ref> Hazlett created the Royal Script as part of the origin story for Futhark, connecting it to the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] people's origins from Grizmallt as described in ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'',<ref name="Endnotes" /> a [[2005]] reference book.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> He added Binks' diplomatic incident to show how the Futhark language had deviated from the Royal Script, while having fun using the clumsy character.<ref name="Endnotes" />
